title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from Settings > Security. An email will be sent to the registered email address with a reset link that expires in 24 hours.

title: Update Profile Information
content: To update your profile information such as name and avatar, navigate to your Account Dashboard and click on the 'Edit Profile' button. Changes will take effect immediately.

title: Subscription Plans
content: We offer three subscription plans: Basic (free), Pro ($15/month), and Enterprise ($50/month). Pro includes premium support and advanced analytics. Enterprise includes custom integrations and a dedicated account manager.

title: Cancellation Policy
content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from the Billing page. If you cancel during a billing cycle, you will retain access until the end of that cycle. No prorated refunds are provided.

title: API Rate Limits
content: The public API is rate-limited to 100 requests per minute for Basic users, and 1000 requests per minute for Pro users. Exceeding these limits will result in a 429 Too Many Requests response.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security. It can be enabled in Settings > Security. We support SMS codes and authenticator apps like Google Authenticator.

title: Data Export
content: Users can request a full export of their personal data from the Privacy section in Settings. The export will be delivered as a ZIP file containing JSON documents within 48 hours.
